name: Gabriel
self_text: Hi! I'm Gabriel, a non-binary Italian in my mid 30s with a background in economics. I've been learning to sail lately because I love the open water. Right now, I'm looking for language practice and find that working through problems together is most effective, though I do best with complete silence while working. I'm happy to explain things and can meet in person or online on Saturday mornings, Sunday mornings, or Sunday afternoons.

requests.request_text: I'm searching for a study partner. I need you to be okay with complete silence while working. It would be a nice bonus if you are into working through problems together, but no big deal.
